question: For what purpose should this practice be diligently resorted to at all times?
premises: The practice is to be resorted to always.
It is well and diligently performed.
Its purpose is the destruction of all sin.
inference: This practice should always be diligently resorted to for the destruction of all sin.
uncertainties: The feminine object of su+niṣevitām likely refers to Ganga or the mantra practice from context.
plain_english: It should always be well resorted to for the destruction of all sin.
